slot_note: re-root after architecture 2 (spent at stage 4 on Gate F and retired by the 2026-10-31 batch audit); demographic-social-science is spent for this slot, so a fresh world in general statistics: a hospital pharmacy's batch-compounded doses read against their volume tolerance through the wear of the compounder tubing that fills them
niche: a regional hospital pharmacy's sterile compounding unit deciding which of its batch-compounded products go onto 100 percent gravimetric verification when its IV workflow system goes live in April 2027, the pharmacy's quality policy requiring it where a product's out-of-tolerance doses over 2026 exceeded 10 in 100,000 doses made, when each product is filled on peristaltic compounders whose delivered volume falls as the tubing set wears and only the first dose of each set and one in forty after it is weighed
analyst_test: A strong analyst conforms the compounders' dose logs, the set-up events and the gravimetric check register, reads each product's volume tolerance and the policy's 10 in 100,000 right, and estimates each product's out-of-tolerance doses the textbook way, a capability study of its 2026 weighed doses (the overall mean and spread, normal tails), the share of weighed doses out of tolerance, or the doses the quarantine sorts rejected, and files the products whose weights spread widest; only the doses rebuilt tubing set by tubing set, each dose's delivered volume at the volume its set had pumped, names the set.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each product's proportion of doses outside its volume tolerance, the quantity a process performance study estimates, worked the way distribution assessment works it: the distribution of every dose made is assessed against the limits with the process's own time structure (the tubing's wear between set changes) deciding the tail, not a normal fit to pooled checks; with another field's nouns there is no tubing set, no pumped volume and no tolerance band, and the task stops reading the same.

products coded by the compounder's own product numbers in the dose log and by drug name and strength in the check register, tied only by the product master

world.org_type: regional hospital pharmacy, sterile compounding unit

driver: The decisive quantity is the share of a period's output that fell outside a limit, when the process drifts steadily inside each run between resets and only a sparse sample is checked: a check that finds a breach stops the run and has everything since the last good check sorted, but a run that goes long and is reset before a check lands in its breach carries it unseen; a stationary fit to the checks prices the spread rather than the reach of the long runs, the checked share and the sorts are far too sparse for a tail this rare, and only each run's drift read from its checks, carried to every unit it made up to its reset, counts the output past the limit.
driver_concrete: Each batch-compounded product's out-of-tolerance doses in 2026 per 100,000 doses made, rebuilt tubing set by tubing set: each dose's expected delivered volume at the volume its set had pumped since set-up (the start each set-up's calibration gave and the loss per litre the weighed doses show, the checks placed on the set-up events and the dose log) against the scatter about that line; not the capability study's normal fit to the year's weighed doses, which flags the products whose sets lose most of the band and misses the ones whose sets ran long, nor the weighed doses' own out-of-tolerance share or the quarantine sorts' rejects, which see almost none of a tail this rare.
stump: The default path runs the textbook capability study on each product's 2026 weighed doses (overall mean and standard deviation, normal tails, the out-of-tolerance rate a Ppk implies) and puts on verification the products whose sets lose most of the tolerance band before they are changed, while missing the ones whose sets were run through extra batches; the step that lands it there is reading the weights as one stationary distribution, when every dose's volume falls with the litres its tubing set has pumped and resets at the next set-up, so the out-of-tolerance doses are the ends of the long sets, read only by placing the weighed doses on the set-up events and the dose log.

differentiation.task271: task271 v2 reads a member's state through a latent class model of survey callbacks; here a dose's volume tail is read through the wear of the tubing between set-ups, no survey and no latent class
differentiation.task308: task308 v1 sizes a launch's unmet requests where supply ran out at every peak; here nothing is unmet: every dose is logged and the decisive step is each dose's volume at its set's pumped litres
differentiation.task471: task471 v1 completes trip totals from replies that come back only on some days; here every dose is counted and the decisive step is the drift inside each tubing set, not a response pattern
differentiation.task482: task482 v8 carries a fast record through a measured lag to a slow quantity; here there is no lag and no second instrument: one weighed volume drifts with tubing wear and resets at each set-up
differentiation.task252: task252 reads an analyser's mean error that grows back after each maintenance flush upstream of every reference; here the weighed doses see the drift directly and the decisive step is the rare tail of the long runs, read per run against a stationary fit
differentiation.task274: task274 divides each result by its calibration's bias anchored at one check; here no calibration bias is carried: the volume drifts within each set and the tail of every dose made is priced from the drift
differentiation.task229: task229 v2 builds a share of units in a correct state at one moment from what each accrued since its last check; here no state at a moment is read: the call is the rare tail of a year's output, priced dose by dose from each run's drift, against a capability study that reads the checks as stationary

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-21 at stage 4: both isolated scored readers corrected each counsellor-day's approve-after-approve contrast for the short-queue bias by permuting the day's determinations and landed the 11 (Gate F)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how strongly each unit's yes-or-no decisions depend on its previous decision inside short sessions whose mix of cases varies; pooling the sessions credits the mix with a positive dependence, comparing within sessions builds in a negative one that short sessions produce on their own, and only the excess over what each session's own decisions would show in any order measures it.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each hospital's sequence effect is the drop in its counsellors' approval rate right after an approval against right after a denial, measured as the excess over what each working day's own decisions would give in any order; pooling consecutive decisions credits the busy outreach days with strings of approvals and clears almost every hospital, and a day-by-day regression charges every hospital with the drop that an eight-decision day shows even when no counsellor is swayed.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst who conforms the three exports and holds each working day's mix fixed by regressing every determination on the counsellor's previous one with a fixed effect per counsellor-day puts 23 of the 31 hospitals over the six-point line, because a short queue shows a drop after an approval with no counsellor swayed, and one who pools consecutive determinations puts 2 over it, because days fed by presumptive referrals string approvals together; only the excess over what each day's own determinations would show in any order puts the 11 hospitals whose counsellors are really swayed over it.

lineage.driver: A household's yearly income is read from one quarter's income scaled to the year; for households whose earnings follow a season, the scaled quarter overstates the year when the quarter is the season's peak and understates it in the slack months, and the season's timing differs by place and by kind of work, so judging each household against a yearly line by its scaled quarter, or through one calendar pooled across places or across kinds of work, misplaces them; each place's calendar for each kind of work is read from how the scaled quarter moves with the month across that place's households in that work, and each quarter is put on the yearly basis by its own month's factor.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each hospital's share of its counsellors' 2025 first-review decisions on households within the free-care limit on their income over the twelve months before applying that left the household owing more than half of its balance (a denial or a 25 percent discount), the twelve-month income rebuilt from the three months the 2025 policy recorded through the calendar of the main earner's kind of work in the hospital's region (the policy's yearly figure averaged by month of application over 2024 and 2025, set against the year's average), not the policy's three months times four and not a calendar pooled across regions or across kinds of work.
lineage.niche: a health foundation's FY2027 decision-coaching grants for its collaborative's hospital financial-assistance teams, one per hospital whose 2025 decisions most often left households that the collaborative's 2026 standard makes eligible on their income over the twelve months before applying owing more than half of their balance, when the 2025 policy read income from the three months before the application and much of the region's work follows harvest, packing, fishing, logging and resort seasons
lineage.stump: A competent analyst who conforms the three hubs, keeps each application's first review and takes the 2025 policy's yearly figure (the three months before the application times four) as the household's income over the twelve months before it applied names 5 hospitals (H11, H15, H17, H23 and H26) for the FY2027 grants, because a household whose pay follows a harvest, packing, fishing, logging or resort season was assessed on one quarter of its year; one calendar for every seasonal kind of work files 6, one for each kind of work across regions 10, one for each region or each hospital across kinds of work 10; only each region's calendar for each kind of work names the 16.
